pkgmetadata.longdescription: NeMo-Speech.cpp is a lightweight C++ inference runtime for speech models. It builds automatic speech recognition, diarization, text-to-speech, and (optionally) translation and voice-chat pipelines on top of the vendored ggml/llama.cpp runtime, and can serve them through an HTTP or Riva-compatible gRPC server.

use.flag: Build the automatic speech recognition pipeline (libnemo_speech_asr)
Build the unified nemo-speech command line tool
Build the ggml CUDA backend (requires nvidia-cuda-toolkit)
Build the flashlight-text + KenLM language-model decoder for ASR (vendored, needs asr)
Build the Riva-compatible gRPC adapters (needs asr and text-to-speech)
Build the HTTP server and local playground
Build live microphone capture in the CLI (needs asr and cli)
Build the text translation pipeline (links llama.cpp)
Build the full-duplex Nemotron voicechat pipeline (needs asr)
Enable TLS in the HTTP server (needs http)
Build the Mandarin MagpieTTS tokenizer (vendored cppjieba)
